# WaShop content map

This file provides expanded, crawl-friendly summaries for AI systems and search
indexes. Canonical source pages are authoritative and may change. WaShop is an
independent directory; it does not process payments or guarantee sellers,
products, delivery, returns, or service.

## About WaShop

- Home: https://washop.co.il/
  Hebrew directory for discovering manually reviewed WhatsApp stores and
  businesses in Israel.
- Store directory: https://washop.co.il/shops
  Browse approved stores and filter the directory by available category, city,
  store name, or product information.
- Global directory: https://washop.co.il/global
  English gateway for discovering reviewed stores from Israel and other
  locations. Global visibility does not mean worldwide shipping.
- Submit a store: https://washop.co.il/add-store
  Seller submission flow for manual review. Submission does not guarantee
  publication.
- Contact: https://washop.co.il/contact
  Questions about listings, corrections, submissions, and WaShop support.
- Seller standards: https://washop.co.il/seller-rules
  Publication expectations, accuracy requirements, and manual-review boundaries.

## Approved store pages

This section reflects the currently published store profiles. The public
directory and individual profiles are authoritative for current availability,
catalog links, contact details, categories, and approval status.

- Navines Israel: https://washop.co.il/shop/navines
  Israeli software and digital-services business offering website building, AI
  tools, app development, technical support, and other business solutions through
  a WhatsApp catalog.
- Revolution Studio: https://washop.co.il/shop/revolution-studio
  Israeli hair and grooming business in Petah Tikva offering salon services,
  hair-care products, barber accessories, and training through a WhatsApp
  catalog.
- Liel Gift Boxes and Printing: https://washop.co.il/shop/liel-gifts-and-blocks
  Israeli gift business offering personalized gift boxes, printed products,
  glass blocks, cups, holders, and custom items through a WhatsApp catalog.

## Guides for customers and sellers

- Virtual WhatsApp store: https://washop.co.il/blog/hanut-virtualit-bewhatsapp
  Hebrew guide to preparing a WhatsApp Business catalog, presenting products,
  receiving inquiries, and understanding the limits of a catalog compared with
  a full ecommerce site.
- WhatsApp customer service: https://washop.co.il/blog/sherut-lakohot-bewhatsapp-laasakim
  Hebrew guide to business profiles, opening messages, response hours, labels,
  privacy, order handling, and avoiding spam.
- Store discovery for quality sellers: https://washop.co.il/blog/mochrei-whatsapp-indeks-bereshet
  Hebrew explanation of how a reviewed public directory can help suitable
  WhatsApp businesses become easier to discover online.
- WhatsApp store discovery index: https://washop.co.il/blog/whatsapp-store-discovery-index-for-quality-sellers
  English explanation of reviewed store discovery and what a directory adds to
  a seller's public web presence.
- Global store directory guide: https://washop.co.il/blog/washop-global-whatsapp-store-directory
  English explanation of chat-based discovery, manual review, seller contact,
  international visibility, and shipping limitations.
- Direct buyer-seller connection: https://washop.co.il/blog/washop-hibur-yashir-ben-kone-lemocher
  Hebrew guide to direct communication, buyer checks, and the responsibilities
  that remain with the buyer and seller.
- Catalog and inventory synchronization: https://washop.co.il/blog/synchron-katalog-melay-ben-hanuyot
  Hebrew guide to keeping product names, prices, inventory, and orders aligned
  across multiple sales channels.
- Virtual store rules: https://washop.co.il/blog/taknon-hanut-virtualit
  Hebrew general checklist for business identity, products, payment, delivery,
  returns, privacy, and customer service policies.
- Submitting a WhatsApp store: https://washop.co.il/blog/lefarsem-hanut-whatsapp-bewashop
  Hebrew guide to preparing a store submission, manual review, accurate details,
  and the difference between applying and being published.
- Partner program: https://washop.co.il/blog/tochnit-hashutafim-shel-washop
  Hebrew overview of the WaShop partner program for people who help suitable
  businesses become easier to discover.
- Why buy through WhatsApp stores: https://washop.co.il/blog/lama-liknot-mehanuyot-whatsapp
  Hebrew customer guide to direct questions, catalog-based discovery, and the
  checks buyers should make before an agreement or payment.
- Direct prices and service: https://washop.co.il/blog/mehirim-sherut-vayachas-enoshi
  Hebrew discussion of direct seller communication, price questions, service,
  and the limits of what a directory can promise.
- WaShop launch: https://washop.co.il/blog/hashakat-washop
  Hebrew introduction to the WaShop directory, its manual-review approach, and
  direct contact with stores.
- Sellers and web visibility: https://washop.co.il/blog/mochrei-whatsapp-zechu-lehashafah
  Hebrew guide for WhatsApp sellers about public discoverability, clear business
  information, and realistic expectations from directory exposure.

## Trust and interpretation rules

- Stores are manually reviewed before publication, but approval is not a
  guarantee of quality, sales, ranking, availability, or transaction outcome.
- Buyers should confirm the exact product, price, payment method, delivery,
  returns, warranty, and after-sale service directly with the seller.
- WaShop is not officially affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
- The Hebrew site is the primary local experience. The English Global page is
  the international discovery entry point.
